steps.name: Epilogue ~ Hide-and-Seek
steps.objective: Watch the conversation between [Shiina] and a visitor in 「Magic Academy Lobby」.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Sis...?
(Shiina is startled by her visitor, then runs into her arms with a radiant smile.)

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Sis!

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Shiina, have you been well?
(Dayna strokes Shiina's head as they embrace, then gently eases her back, as though about to lose her balance.)

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Sorry, Dayna. I almost knocked you over, didn't I?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: If I fell, I'd roll all the way down to El Anoir Plains.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Oh, Sis. What brings you here without a word? It's not as though the chairman blew you in on the wind...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I have something to discuss with Headmistress Chloris and Chairman Zephyros. And I thought I'd see my lovely little sister while I was here.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Couldn't I hear that discussion too?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Shiina, I...

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Sis, I'm part of the imperial family too. Your concerns are mine as well. Why hesitate?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Even so, not today. But I promise I'll tell you when the time is right.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: I'll wait, Dayna. On one condition...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: A condition?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Have a meal with me in the dining hall. That will be enough for today.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: All right.
(Just as Dayna is about to pat Shiina's shoulder, she withdraws her hand. She quickly raises her staff and steps in front of Shiina.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Shiina, get behind me.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Sis?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: It's gone.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Yes, it seems safe now. It's gone...
(At Shiina's words, Dayna turns back in surprise.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Shiina? What did you say? Gone...? Shiina...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Since when have you been able to sense things like this?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: I suppose since I started learning magic...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: This isn't something magic can sense. This is...

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: I'm sorry, Sis. And... Sis?
(Dayna quietly draws Shiina into an embrace.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Don't apologize. Our little sister has done nothing wrong. This is...

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Dayna, don't hate Her Majesty... I mean, our eldest sister.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: All right. I won't.
(Dayna takes Shiina's hand and offers a gentle smile.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I'll make an exception and tell you this time.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Sis?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Take me to Chairman Zephyros and Headmistress Chloris. Then we'll eat together as soon as we're done.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Of course, Dayna. The dining hall has a good menu today.
(Dayna and Shiina depart. A girl who seems to have been watching them for some time emerges.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: I thought I could hide somewhere so full of magic, but this place won't work either.

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: What could those two have been through...?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Not my business... I'd better go.
(As the girl turns to leave, she bumps into someone. The other person falls, and the girl hurriedly helps them up.)

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry. Wait...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Found you, little kitten.

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Who are you? And why are you calling me a kitten...?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Me? Just a mercenary captain passing through.

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: How did you see me? Ordinary humans shouldn't be able to...

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I'm used to finding cats, little kitten. Come along. Someone hired me to find you. Will you come?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: It's your choice. Of course, if you want to know who it is, you'll have to follow me.
(In a place where only a campfire crackles, someone sits alone before the flames and sings.)
The promised night we've waited for... I sing a hopeful curse. ♬
To have our wishes granted, we must do what we despise. ♩
La-la-la, la-la-la...
You must survive.
Do not die. Hold on as long as you can. ♬
For there are those who never cease to sing the song of blood...
La-la-la, la-la-la...
And so our story carries on...
O gods, our gods who fled.
Hear the song called forth by the curse you made. Leave us be.
So we may sing the verses left before this night is through...
May we not become the sacrifice of the Night of the Witch...
(Before the song can end, the campfire dies, plunging everything into darkness.)
Thud.
(After the singer collapses, someone new sits down before them and rekindles the fire.)
(And takes up the song where it stopped.)
O girl. O girl who became a new god.
Please! Turn a blind eye to us. ♬
[ Chapter 4: Night of the Witch ]
